test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rani is the mother of a girl named Preeti. Aishwarya is the maternal aunt of a girl named Kajol. Priyanka has only two children, Rani and Aishwarya. Seema is the daughter of Aishwarya. How is Kajol related to preeti?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: 

1) Priyanka has only two children, Rani and Aishwarya.

2) Seema is the daughter of Aishwarya. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ac916839ffe75d6b47aa299bf0bb97b82d5d1f0c3cdc8f487ec867accef6a5f.png] 

3) Rani is the mother of a girl named Preeti.

4) Aishwarya is the maternal aunt of a girl named Kajol. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cafd2f9a45b85f3d43ef2e2d07db3e24e21350f9143f56d792d16c8e84b3f1b.png] 

Here, Kajol is the sister of Preeti.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
